Data Transformation & SQL
Dynamic Budget Cycle Detection
Business Logic
DECLARE @BudgetYear INT;
DECLARE @MonthCurr  INT = DATEPART(MONTH, GETDATE());

IF @MonthCurr IN (1, 2)
    SET @BudgetYear = YEAR(GETDATE());
ELSE
    SET @BudgetYear = YEAR(GETDATE()) + 1;
Window-Based Deduplication
ROW_NUMBER · PARTITION BY
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        p.BudgetToolPropertiesId
       ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.EntityNumber, p.Year
            ORDER BY p.BudgetToolPropertiesId DESC
        ) AS BudgetID_Rank
       ,p.PropertyId
       ,p.EntityNumber
       ,p.Year
    FROM CMFFIBTPRODDB01.BT_PROD_South.dbo.BudgetToolProperties AS p
    WHERE p.Year >= YEAR(GETDATE())
) AS prop
    ON  prop.EntityNumber = mlp.Entity_Number
    AND prop.BudgetID_Rank = 1
Status Pipeline Resolution
CASE · Multi-Source Joins
SELECT
    mlp.CamServer
   ,mlp.GL_Entity_ID
   ,mlp.Entity_Number
   ,mlp.Name
   ,mlp.RP                         AS Market
   ,prop.BudgetToolPropertiesId
   ,prop.BudgetID_Rank
   ,sub.Budget_Type
   ,hx_status.hist_created_on_date AS Status_Date
   ,CASE
        WHEN hx_status.Budget_Status IS NULL
            THEN 'Not Submitted'
        WHEN hx_status.Budget_Status = 'Submitted'
            THEN 'Submitted - Pending RD Approval'
        WHEN hx_status.Budget_Status = 'Invoice Number Entered'
            THEN 'Completed'
        ELSE 'Submitted - ' + hx_status.Budget_Status
    END AS Budget_Status
FROM DataAnalytics.dbo.OrgChart_Budgets AS mlp
    LEFT JOIN (...) AS prop   -- ranked properties
    LEFT JOIN (...) AS sub    -- budget type lookup
    LEFT JOIN (...) AS hx_status -- latest status per entity
WHERE mlp.Active = 1
